notes.subject: עזב תעזב
notes.rationale: Sebopego sa确定 infinitive-absolute-plus-finite: 'go tloga o tla e tlogela' — go boeletša go gatelela ga Seheberu, go boletšwe ka 'tloga ka mo feletšego'.

notes.subject: וחדלת מעזב לו
notes.rationale: Bafetoledi ba fapana: KJV 'and wouldest forbear to help him' (potego ya motho) kgatlhanong le ASV/JPS 'thou shalt forbear to leave him' (taelo). Phetolelo ya ka e latela mothalo: o ikgapha go e tlogela.

notes.subject: go Yisraele
notes.rationale: Ditaelo tše ke taelo ya go lebanya go Yisraele ka botee ('o bona', 'o se ke').

translation: Ge o bona tonki ya yo a go hloilego e robetše ka tlase mošolo wa yona, gomme wa ikgapha go e tlogela mo — tloga ka mo feletšego, o tla e tlogela le ena.
